description: A sausage that has been cut into strips at one end so that it splays out like an octopus stands in the oil of a hot black frying pan. Beaten egg is poured from a white bowl all around it and spreads across the pan, and a thin stream of oil is drizzled over the top. The egg sets into a round yellow omelette with the sausage in the middle. The finished omelette is slid out of the pan onto a white plate and chopped green spring onion is sprinkled over it.

en.question: What is cooking in the pan?
